events_seen: TRADE (Jul 17): Adam receives Justin Herbert (QB, LAC). Fronge receives Jacory Croskey-Merritt (RB, WAS), C.J. Stroud (QB, HOU), 2028 R1 pick.
TRADE (Jul 10): Adam receives Keaton Mitchell (RB, LAC). Wingard receives 2028 R3 pick.
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 21): Drew added Colbie Young (WR, CIN) (dropped Joe Mixon (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 08): Adam added Cyrus Allen (WR, KC) (dropped Phil Mafah (RB, DAL)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 27): Charles added Chris Brooks (RB, GB) for $1 FAAB (dropped Austin Ekeler (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 16): Charles added Matt Hibner (TE, BAL) (dropped Moliki Matavao (TE, NO)).
CUT (May 16): Charles released Zonovan Knight (RB, ARI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 13): Shaq added Zavion Thomas (WR, CHI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 12): Adam added John Michael Gyllenborg (TE, KC) (dropped Elijah Higgins (TE, ARI)).
CUT (May 11): Jake released Evan Hull (RB, HOU).

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: Still watching the Deepwater situation. What I can tell you is that the board pressure Mitchum is operating under isn't theoretical — it's structural. The assets exist to make a move. The hesitation is on him. That gap doesn't usually stay open this long into an offseason.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Wingard traded a 2028 third-rounder for Keaton Mitchell to go to Helix and I have watched this league for two years and I genuinely cannot tell you if Sovereign Draft Reserve is playing chess or just hoarding pieces because the box is pretty.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: Crownline at $135.34 is still the number everyone chases and I'm starting to think that's exactly the problem. The measuring stick doesn't win championships in this league. We have direct evidence of that. One season. Inaugurally.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Obsidian is the roster that orders a premium steak and then realizes they forgot to book a table. Bowers is generational TE value in a TE-premium format, and Brent has built almost nothing around him that can close out a season. The cut of meat doesn't matter if the kitchen never opens.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Charles dropped Austin Ekeler for Chris Brooks off waivers and released Zonovan Knight in the same window. People want to debate the Herbert trade. I want to know what is happening at the Crownline running back desk. Championship-or-bust and the backfield is being assembled with a coupon code.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: The EchoPoint RB backfield is legitimately elite and nobody in this building will stop talking about the empty TE slot long enough to acknowledge that. Jake has the ground game to survive a brutal stretch in a 14-week season. The ceiling question is real. The floor question is answered.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Tonight we have Terrence on Crownline's roster moves, Dina with a Deepwater update, and Chad has submitted a pre-written take about the Havana relocation that legal has asked me to preview before air. That last part is new.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: The market spent the entire offseason calling the Helix rebuild a redemption arc and skipping right past the part where Adam's TE room is still exposed wiring. I flagged the positional liability before the Herbert deal closed. The exchange price reflects the QB. It does not reflect what happens when a tight end matters in January.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: ForgeHammer's Havana relocation is actually an underrated competitive advantage. Tax documents take longer to file internationally. That's two extra days per trade window. Fronge isn't avoiding regulation — he's buying processing time. This is the most sophisticated desk move of the offseason.
